title: Energy Metering and Billing Regulations 2025
text: Energy consumption exceeding 1000 kWh per day for residential customers must be monitored and investigated for potential meter tampering or fraud.

title: Energy Metering and Billing Regulations 2025
text: Customers with unusually low consumption relative to property type and baseline must undergo meter inspection and verification.

title: Energy Metering and Billing Regulations 2025
text: All energy meters must be monitored for unusual or suspicious consumption patterns and reported if tampering is suspected.

title: Energy Metering and Billing Regulations 2025
text: Meters with low trust scores or manual reading requirements must be inspected quarterly for evidence of tampering or bypass.

title: Energy Theft Prevention and Detection Regulation 2024
text: Consumption patterns showing sudden drops of 50% or more compared to baseline must trigger immediate field investigation for potential illegal connections.

title: Energy Theft Prevention and Detection Regulation 2024
text: New customers with abnormally high consumption during their first 30 days require enhanced verification including physical meter inspection.

title: Smart Metering Standards
text: Energy providers must implement monitoring systems to detect unauthorized meter access or consumption bypass attempts.

title: Smart Metering Standards
text: Automated meter reading systems must flag irregularities such as reversed polarity, zero consumption during occupied periods, or consumption outside normal ranges.

title: Energy Compliance and Reporting Regulations
text: All suspected cases of energy theft or meter tampering must be reported to regulatory authorities within 48 hours of detection.

title: Energy Compliance and Reporting Regulations
text: Customers with past fraud history must be subject to monthly consumption audits and enhanced monitoring for a minimum of 12 months.

title: Illegal Connection Detection Rules 2025
text: Residential properties with consumption patterns exceeding 200% of baseline must undergo physical inspection for evidence of illegal connections to neighboring meters.

title: Illegal Connection Detection Rules 2025
text: Energy providers must monitor consumption patterns across adjacent meters to detect potential cross-connections or energy diversion.

title: Illegal Connection Detection Rules 2025
text: Before processing new service requests, verification of meter integrity and absence of unauthorized connections must be completed and documented.
